description: Lists the initiatives in a repository, and the container issues inside them, that hold at least the dashboard's threshold (default 70) of the 100 sub-issues GitHub allows one parent, fullest first: each with its sub-issue count, how many of those are closed, how many slots are free, and whether it is full. GitHub refuses a parent's 101st sub-issue, and closed sub-issues keep their slots. Use it before you add a sub-issue to an initiative, when your human asks why GitHub refused one, or to suggest which initiatives to split. Read-only, and it never fails: if the list cannot be read it says why.

repo.description: owner/name. Optional when the token covers one repository.
